summary: Iteration 6: Testing of 2 new features - 1) Summary popup on Library book cards, 2) Admin CMS button removed from Dashboard. Both features verified working. Backend: 18/18 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI tests passed.

Summary popup shows book title, author, genre, and summary text
Summary popup has 'Start Reading' and 'Listen' action buttons
Dashboard page does NOT show Admin CMS button (correctly removed)
Dashboard shows expected buttons: AI Story Creator, New Book
Admin CMS accessible at /admin route with separate authentication
Admin dashboard shows all books, users, and analytics
Book API returns summary fields (description, back_cover_text)
Featured books API returns summary fields
AI image generation endpoint exists and requires auth
AI video generation endpoint exists and requires auth
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both requested features working: 1) Summary popup on Library book cards - hover over book to reveal info icon (FiInfo) in top-right corner, click to open popup with book summary, author info, and action buttons. 2) Admin CMS button removed from Dashboard/My Books page - users no longer see this button.
